clauses.text: Kiddoz Uniform House, a school uniform niche shop.
Puan Zarina Ahmad, the owner, writes and approves every campaign. The shop has 1 to 3 staff and no marketing staff.
Primary and secondary school uniforms, prefect and student leader uniforms, religious school uniforms, sports and PE clothing, and co-curricular uniforms.

Parents buy at the Bangi shop or contact Kiddoz through WhatsApp. The default call to action is: visit the Bangi shop or contact Kiddoz through WhatsApp. The WhatsApp number is added by the owner when posting; copy writes [No. WhatsApp] where it belongs. There is no online store and no delivery service.
Parents of primary and secondary school pupils in Bangi and nearby areas, preparing for the new school session.
